about.label: ABOUT BREEDVISION
about.title: Empowering Livestock Recognition with AI
about.p1: BreedVision is an AI-powered platform that helps you identify cattle and buffalo breeds instantly from an image. Our advanced model is trained on thousands of images to deliver accurate predictions along with detailed information about each breed.
about.p2: Whether you are a farmer, researcher, student, or livestock enthusiast, BreedVision makes breed identification simple, fast and accessible.
